c05.title: Sealed Heaven — Qinghe
c05.far: Too far · approach the target first
c05.controls: WASD / arrows: move (hold to repeat). Space: pause/resume. N: step. Tab / click: select target. E / action button: interact. F5/F9: save/load. R: reset. L: language. C: follow player. Paused actions queue; N or resume commits them. No action while paused changes the world.
c05.ready: Enter Qinghe: Space to resume; approach Yun and press E.
c05.queued: Action queued for the next tick
c05.queue_full: Input queue full — step/resume to drain it
c05.resolved: Action resolved by the canonical simulation
c05.request: Yun: Gather a spirit herb east of the gate. Deliver it to the healing shrine south of me.
c05.complete: Herb delivered. The shrine keeps it; your deed persists.
c05.unmet: Find Healer Yun and ask about the herb request.
c05.delivered_ok: Transferred one herb to the shrine
c05.r_out_of_range: Target is not within one cell
c05.r_empty: No herb available in the required inventory
c05.r_npc: No herb request from that NPC
c05.r_overflow: Resource capacity exceeded; no transfer applied
